official.deadline_note: Application portal opened 7 September 2026 at 8 a.m. GST for all graduate programmes except M.Sc. and Ph.D. Computational Biology, which opened 30 September 2026 at 8 a.m. GST. The Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence has a later deadline of 28 February 2027. Decision notification 31 March 2027 and offer response deadline 15 April 2027.
official.status_note: The graduate admissions pages publish a final application deadline of 15 December 2026 (5 p.m. GST) for all graduate programmes except the Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence, with decision notification on 31 March 2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Funded students receive free tuition fees.
benefits: One return airfare each year to the student's home country
Health insurance for the approved funding period
University-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID where eligible
eligibility: Degree in a STEM field such as computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, mathematics, physics, or other relevant science or engineering majors
From an accredited university or college recognized by the UAE Ministry of Education (MoE)
Minimum CGPA of 3.0 or 3.5 on a scale of 4.0 depending on the programme
Senior-level students can apply initially with a copy of their transcript and upon admission must submit official complete degree certificate and transcript
A degree attestation for degrees from the UAE, or a Certificate of Recognition for degrees acquired outside the UAE, should be furnished within the first semester at MBZUAI
requirements: Submit only one application per admission cycle; multiple submissions will not be processed
Take the technical interview if invited
documents: Copy of transcript (senior-level applicants may apply with a copy of their transcript)
Official complete degree certificate and transcript, required upon admission
Degree attestation (UAE degrees) or Certificate of Recognition (degrees acquired outside the UAE), to be furnished within the first semester
coverage: Free tuition fees for funded students
A monthly stipend (published as AED 15,500 for M.Sc. and AED 17,500 for Ph.D. for international students; AED 37,500 for M.Sc. and AED 43,500 for Ph.D. for UAE nationals)
One return airfare each year to the student's home country
Health insurance for the approved funding period
University-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID where eligible
application_method: Choose your admission pathway on the MBZUAI admissions page (graduate master's or graduate Ph.D.)
Submit one application through the MBZUAI application portal for the cycle, observing the single-application rule
Upload the curriculum vitae, statement of purpose, research statement and supporting documents
Prepare for and complete the screening exam
Take the technical interview if invited
Await the decision notification on 31 March 2027 and respond to any offer by 15 April 2027
official.application_route: Single application through the MBZUAI graduate admissions portal; there is no separate faculty matching or funding application and eligible applicants are considered for merit-based funding during the admissions review process.
official.study_mode: Full-time, on campus; funded students are expected to maintain an in-person presence throughout their funded period
official.international_eligibility: Open to students of all nationalities; stipend rates are published separately for UAE nationals and international students.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: STEM degree in computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or another relevant science or engineering major. The Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence is fee-based and is not eligible for University or faculty-sponsored funding.
official.research_requirement: A research statement is required. M.Sc. funding depends on securing a faculty advisor-sponsored research or teaching assistantship, or an approved government scholarship for UAE nationals.
official.description: MBZUAI's graduate funding model is built on a partnership between the University and faculty advisors: funding, benefits and continued eligibility depend on the student's programme, academic standing, and for M.Sc. students on whether they have secured a faculty-sponsored research or teaching assistantship or an approved government scholarship. Funded students receive free tuition fees, a monthly stipend, annual return airfare, health insurance and University-sponsored visa and Emirates ID.

applicant_utility.summary: Apply once and apply well, because MBZUAI processes only one submission per admission cycle and the Fall 2027 portal closes at 5 p.m. GST on 15 December 2026 with decisions on 31 March 2027 and an offer response deadline of 15 April 2027. Do not assume funding comes with admission: M.Sc. students are fee-paying by default and are funded only through a faculty advisor-sponsored research or teaching assistantship or, for UAE nationals, an approved government scholarship, so your research statement and referee recommendations are doing the real work. Keep the Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence out of your plan if you need funding, since it is fee-based at AED 5,000 per credit for a total of AED 170,000 and is excluded from University and faculty-sponsored funding.
applicant_utility.best_fit: STEM graduates with a strong CGPA (3.0-3.5 or above on a 4.0 scale depending on programme) applying to M.Sc. or Ph.D. programmes in AI who can secure or attract a faculty advisor's research sponsorship.
application_readiness_checklist: Write the research statement against the specific work of the faculty group you hope to join, not against AI in general
Arrange referee recommendations from people who can speak to research potential, since funding depends on advisor sponsorship
Check your degree qualifies for attestation (UAE) or a Certificate of Recognition (outside the UAE) and start that process early
Budget for the AED 200 application fee, which must be paid for the application to proceed to review
Plan around the 31 March 2027 decision date and the 15 April 2027 offer response deadline before committing to competing offers
common_rejection_risks: Submitting multiple applications in the same cycle, which are simply not processed
Applying to M.Sc. expecting automatic funding when funding depends on a faculty advisor-sponsored assistantship
Choosing the Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence and discovering it is excluded from University and faculty-sponsored funding
Leaving degree attestation or the Certificate of Recognition past the first semester
A statement of purpose and research statement that do not name a concrete research direction
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: For unfunded M.Sc. students, tuition and fees apply; full Cost of Attendance figures for Fall 2027 were still being finalized at the time of verification. Funded students should expect to fund any off-campus or family accommodation themselves.
document_audit: Senior-level applicants may apply with a transcript copy but must submit the official complete degree certificate and transcript upon admission
Degree attestation (UAE degrees) or a Certificate of Recognition (degrees from outside the UAE) must be furnished within the first semester
Students receiving external scholarships or fellowships must disclose the funding, which normally replaces rather than tops up the University stipend
alerts: Funded students must maintain an in-person on-campus presence throughout the funded period and need approval before being away
Ph.D. Year 1 funding is centrally funded by the University while a faculty advisor match is arranged, and moves to the faculty advisor's funding no later than the start of Year 2
M.Sc. and Ph.D. Computational Biology opened a month later than other graduate programmes, on 30 September 2026

Admission is highly competitive with limited places in each incoming cohort, and MBZUAI states that 43% of its incoming graduate students for 2026-2027 came from the world's top computer science universities
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One portal application with CV, statement of purpose, research statement and referees, then a screening exam and technical interview if invited, with the decision published on 31 March 2027.
